thread:
Maria: Quick sync — we need a concise 1-pager + launch post for enterprise secure deploys (VPC & on-prem). Target: field + AEs. Focus areas: SLAs, inbound routing playbook, benchmark narrative, and a webinar CTA. Who can own which pieces?

Tom: I can take the routing playbook + AE cheat sheet. Can we reuse bits from the deploy-mode matrix?

Jess: I'll own the 1-pager + the benchmark narrative. Need an example persona and any recent perf numbers to cite.

Raj: I'll pull perf numbers. FYI use the RDW-quantized L2-13b runs we did last week as baseline. Also propose three lead paths: self-serve trial, field-assisted Dedicated, enterprise Private (sales-assisted).

Sam: For inbound routing: add form fields that capture security requirements (SOC2, ISO, on-prem req), a "priority SLA" checkbox, and a selector for desired deployment mode. That drives routing to the right AE/SE.

DeployBot: release-notes: benchmark csv uploaded -> s3://redwood-inference/benchmarks/rdw-l2-13b-2026-03.csv :white_check_mark:

Maria: Perfect. Jess — keep claims conservative. Example benchmark line we can use as a starter: "Dedicated configs show ~2x steady throughput vs hosted for sustained QPS with ~1.4x better cost per token for long-running production workloads." Can you craft a 2-3 sentence narrative around that?

Jess: Yep. Draft outline for the one-pager/webinar: 1) Pain: unpredictable inference economics + compliance needs. 2) How Redwood addresses it: unified API, routing, KV caching, quantization profiles, Dedicated & Private. 3) Benchmarks: latency & cost trade-offs (hosted vs dedicated vs private). 4) Field playbook + routing. 5) CTA: schedule a "secure deploy workshop" or join webinar.

Tom: AE cheat sheet idea: 5-sentence pitch, 3 qualifying questions, routing checklist. I'll draft the cheat sheet (short bulleted).

Raj: Quick perf note — preliminary numbers from the CSV: p95 latency ~120ms for hosted 8k-seq, Dedicated p95 ~100ms with higher sustained throughput. I'll forward exact table. Legal also flagged we need a short on-prem compliance blurb — I'll loop Legal and drop copy here.

Jess: For the benchmark snippet I'll add a tiny visual concept: a 2-column stat block showing "Latency (p95)" and "Cost per 1M tokens" for Hosted vs Dedicated. Keep it non-branded and footnote the test setup.

Maria: Timing: want first draft of one-pager + AE cheat sheet by EOD tomorrow so we can review before Friday's field sync. Webinar date options: pick two slots next week — Wed 9am PT or Thu 1pm PT. Which is better?

Sam: Wed 9am PT looks best from sales' calendar. I'll also implement the inbound form fields in Intercom/HubSpot and add a hidden campaign tag for tracking (utm + routing tag).

Tom: Will include simple routing rules: if "on-prem" or "SOC2=yes" -> route to Enterprise AE queue; if "priority SLA" -> add urgent tag and notify SEs. I'll write the exact steps.

Jess: Drafting now. Example copy for the hero line: "Secure, predictable LLM inference for regulated teams — pick Hosted, Dedicated, or Private with clear SLAs and routing to match." Thoughts?

Raj: Sounds good. Legal blurb incoming in ~2 hours. Also adding a short line about data residency for EU customers.

Maria: Action items recap: Jess = one-pager + benchmark narrative + webinar outline. Tom = AE cheat sheet + routing playbook. Raj = perf table + legal/compliance blurb. Sam = inbound form fields + tracking. I'll book a 30m review for tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar: :rocket:

Sam: ACK. Will add a tag for conversion tracking so we can measure MQL -> AE handoff.

Jess: Will share first draft link (Google Slides + Doc) when done. Expect by EOD tomorrow.

Maria: Thanks team — let's keep the messaging tight and field-ready. Ping me here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
